details:
A few of my requested features in vr chat:

VR chat Fanmade Update 2024.4.4 - Groups Safety and SEKAI:

1 - Groups are now safer for everyone:

banned groups are invisible: when you search the banned group, it is not shown on groups.

when you see a group marked as "banned" and grayed out instead of "join this" or "request", it means you have been kicked and banned from the group from an instance. when you click banned, it no longer receives banned group notifications.

when reporting a group, you see "banned" as a third option instead of "text" or "image".

added a feature that someone representing the banned group you joined is no longer showing after you ban the group instance.

the instances in banned group instances are separated from the group you banned. the first one you joined is banned from a group and the second one is from the same group but the master is mine after being kicked and banned or the same joined world in a friends plus instance.

2 - pjsekai-like menus: this is an important feature for most pjsekai fans in vrc, the menu has been themed to pjsekai 3rd anniv for fans who loved the franchise Plus the sounds are the same as pjsekai.

Replaced with JPSekai 4th anniv loading music instead of 2020 Default loading music on the loading screen and login screen

3 - main avatars: when you select the most used avatar in vrc as main, it shows off as my main avatar rather than the default robot avatar.

When launching VRC and playing as other avatars, not in the main avatar, are the same here with no differences after you join a home instance.

4 - added "report to unbanned" feature in the main menu to unban a group for future group instances and events or reporting to devs (for example add role-playing to the main group, dont ban me as role, etc).

5 - Custom-themed menus (non-VRC plus feature): this you to download and apply custom pre-made or user-made themes from various franchises, sources and media.

6 - world instances after kicked and the instance marked as "kicked" and grayed out for 60 minutes or group instances is "instance banned" and grayed out.

7 - Group Friends and Group Friends Plus instances: 

like friends or friends plus instances but add a friend that has the same groups you joined or requested.

UDON in VRC request:

1 - LISTS: this feature adds or removes a list of letters or numbers in this world you programming.

2: Variables have been updated for more speed or more smoothness with added new features.

and finally, the pjsekai sounds when you click it (FANMADE feature but the sounds are original from pjsekai)

MOBILE:

Fixed the annoying problem when clicking the user and it goes to the quick menu.

DESKTOP: 

when I exited my vrc, it was not responding, later on, it fixed it without responding

WEB: 

No-showed groups after the group is banned myself.
title: Group Safety Updates, PJSekai-style and Miscellaneous Features
